description: Find public games to recommend by name, keyword, or genre. Returns game summaries, player counts, availability, and website links, plus the number of matching games. Check status before sending someone to play.

category.description: Exact game genre. Omit to search across every genre.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching games to return. Use total and truncated to tell whether more matches exist.

query.description: Case-insensitive match in game names, descriptions, and tags. Omit for all titles.

name: list_games
title: Discover public Tailor Game games
